d: Short, chestnut brown hair with straight texture and bangs sweeping across the forehead. Small, narrow hazel eyes behind silver-rimmed glasses, set on a round face with a youthful, adolescent appearance. A heavy-set build wearing a brown coat over a white collared shirt, paired with an olive-green vest and a prominent orange ascot tied with a gold circular brooch. Holding a staff topped with a green orb, with a colorful illustrative banner depicting three female characters draped across the shoulder.
